symptom: Vault v109 schema exactInstant accepted arbitrary non-date strings and lowercase t/z when a Draft 2020-12 consumer did not opt into format assertion, while runtime rejected those values.
lesson: JSON Schema format:date-time is annotation unless the consumer enables format assertion; a negative-offset-only regex does not enforce timestamp syntax. Schema-only preflight must fail closed on malformed lexical input independent of format-checker configuration.
guardrail: Use a shared exactInstant lexical pattern with uppercase T/Z, bounded date/time/offset components, year-zero and unknown-offset exclusion for all five fields. Keep runtime/format-checker validation for Gregorian calendar validity and do not claim regex alone proves a real instant.
